what: calibration of the frozen readout (keeper left / right / centre)
note: calibration only; these are not kicks
model: Shiu et al. 2024 LIF (Brian2), FlyWire v783
readout: steer = (Rturn - Lturn) / (Rturn + Lturn + 1); Rturn = DNa01_R + DNa02_R + DNb05_R + DNg13_R + DNb06_L; power = oDN1_L + oDN1_R

constants.decision_ms: lower-median spike time of the 10 turning neurons, ms (1000 if silent)

test.rule: reacts = Welch p < 0.01 (keeper_right vs keeper_left steer); flips = mean signs differ; direction = toward_keeper if mean steer(right) > mean steer(left)

runtime.machine: Apple M2 Pro, 16 GB, Brian2 runtime (Cython), 1 process
